rapport_notes: Brianne maintains a consistently warm, professional tone with active listening and genuine engagement throughout the call.
process_discipline_notes: No silence held after 'does that all make sense?' (launched straight into pricing explanation). The close fails to include an explicit rate-lock statement or clear ask to book ('if you would like to get on our books you can respond or callback' is passive).

evidence_quotes.agenda: Before we start do you have any specific questions or concerns regarding this move that you would like answered on this call?
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer raises concern about three movers vs. two. Rep acknowledges and gives a brief answer ('sometimes the third person gets more in the way') but does not probe deeper (e.g., 'tell me more about why three matters to you' or 'what specifically worries you about two movers?'). No follow-up on the customer's stated reasoning about solid wooden pieces and stairs.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: Obviously there are a number of factors when you know, estimating time for the move and the most important one is how well prepared you are when we get there... the less time we take the less money you end up spending at the end of the day. [Self-prep tip, estimate-is-a-window framing present.] We also do not require a deposit to get on our schedule and there's actually no fee to change or cancel as well. [No 'commit to the rate' framing, no 'if the crew beats it pay less' 15-min language, no 'does that feel fair' followed by silence.]
evidence_quotes.sheet1_damage: We do have our no worries, damage coverage. Which is our free valu evaluation coverage included in our alley rate rides up to $2,000 per move. To repair, replace or reimburse for accidental damages.
evidence_quotes.sheet2_meet_your_mover: A few days before you move you'll receive and meet your mover fee email introducing them to you helping ease attention of strangers arriving at your front door.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee: We have our on time guarantee we value your time. So, if we can't make it in the time window that we arranged, we immediately start discounting money of your final bill.

top_strength: Brianne expertly handles a complex multi-option scenario (2 vs. 3 movers, Oct 2 vs. 3 vs. 30) while keeping the customer feeling supported and informed; she asks the agenda question early and gathers detailed logistics without feeling rushed.
coaching_note: Dig deeper into customer concerns—when Caleb explained his partner's worry about moving heavy wooden furniture upstairs, probe 'tell me more about that' rather than pivot to 'third person gets in the way'; and at close, include 'your rate locks when you book' plus a clear ask like 'would you like our help with your move?' rather than a passive 'you can respond or callback.'
